test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Ignision**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of '**Ignision**' according to the English dictionary is '**Ignition**'.
 
• The word '**Ignition**' means '**the electrical system in an engine that causes the fuel to burn or explode in order to start the engine**'.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Ignision**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of the other options.
 
 
• **Copulate**- to engage in sexual intercourse.
 
• **Portion**- an individual's part or share of something.
 
• **Horticulture**- the art or practice of garden cultivation and management.
